readme: Reviewed exceptions to the native dependency advisory gate. See .claude/rules/dependency-security.md before editing. Checked by apps/mobile/scripts/native-audit/index.mjs.

exceptions.rationale: CVE-2022-25647 needs Gson.fromJson over untrusted input. The only fromJson in @expo/log-box is ExpoLogBoxWebViewWrapper.kt:75, and that object is constructed solely by ExpoLogBoxSurfaceDelegate, which is installed only when ExpoLogBoxPackage returns a lifecycle listener. It returns emptyList() unless BuildConfig.DEBUG && BuildConfig.EXPO_UNSTABLE_LOG_BOX; release builds have DEBUG false, and EXPO_UNSTABLE_LOG_BOX is compiled from an env var set nowhere in this repository or eas.json. The classes ship in the APK, but no code path can reach them in a release build.

CVE-2021-29425 needs FilenameUtils.normalize over attacker-controlled input. Measured across expo-file-system 56.0.8, 56.0.11 and 57.0.6: the module imports only FileUtils and IOUtils and calls toString, copy, forceDelete, copyFile and copyDirectory; normalize is called nowhere, and nothing under apps/mobile/modules uses commons-io at all. This one does execute in release, unlike the gson entry, so it is accepted rather than dismissed: the fix is a resolutionStrategy.force to 2.16.1, whose five call-site signatures are binary-compatible (checked with javap against the jar), and it ships only after release testing of the download, cache and import flows. Upgrading npm cannot fix it — every published version through the SDK 58 canary declares 1.4.
